gaps.explanation: Detail = budgetary-basis schedules for General Fund (pp12-13, 535,111,291), Street and Highway Allocation (p14, 91,001,352), Debt Service (p31, 94,144,757) and 15 nonmajor funds (pp17-33, 49,608,118) = 769,865,518. The p6 statement (GAAP) columns: General 537,359,899; Debt Service 94,144,757; Grants 57,058,893; Street and Highway 91,001,352; Nonmajor 76,377,938; Total 855,942,839. Parts of the 86,077,321 gap: (1) missing fund column - the major 'Grants' fund has no schedule; its p6 column (Investment income 49,935 + Charges for services 17,576 + Contributions and grants 56,991,382 = 57,058,893) is added. (2) different basis - General Fund budgetary actual 535,111,291 (p12) vs GAAP column 537,359,899 (p6) = 2,248,608 (e.g. property tax 125,847,315 vs 123,154,351, city sales and use 239,580,960 vs 238,698,450, business taxes shown as restaurant/business usage/tobacco lines). (3) page not in trim - Nonmajor Governmental Funds column 76,377,938 vs the 15 nonmajor budget schedules 49,608,118 = 26,769,820 belongs to nonmajor funds that have no budget schedule in the trimmed PDF (capital projects etc.; the combining nonmajor statements are not in the trim). Check: 769,865,518 + 57,058,893 = 826,924,411; remaining 29,018,428 = 2,248,608 + 26,769,820. Only part (1) can be fixed.
